label: monothr99-probe
_why: Does the world-market monopoly threshold matter? (user, 2026-10-17: probe it only if it can affect foreign trade alone - vanilla in-market monopolies are out of scope). FINDINGS F241: vanilla's WORLD_MARKET_MONOPOLY_MIN_SHARE is a DEAD key; the engine registers the setting as NEconomy.WORLD_MARKET_MONOPOLY_THRESHOLD (victoria3.exe define registry), which vanilla never sets, so the game runs on the built-in default. It decides only whether a MARKET counts as monopolising world exports of a good (the world-market price markup, MONOPOLY_PRICE_IMPACT); country and company monopolies are granted on building types and do not read it. ONE run: continue the user's 1935.1.1 autosave (the same file as run 1 of 20261017_190800) with the threshold at 0.99 and compare with that session's canon run 1 - a continuation is deterministic (F241), so any difference is the define's effect.

_arms.thr99: {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.monothr99-probe.json} - the canon + game_defines.NEconomy.WORLD_MARKET_MONOPOLY_THRESHOLD 0.99, nothing else; + telemetry

_comparison: Against 20261017_190800_monopoly99-probe/run001_canon (same save, same canon otherwise, bit-identical across three runs): month-by-month world GDP, pop objects, Japan's exports, and every good's weekly world price over the year. Affected at 0.99 if the default is 0.5: goods where Japan's market holds 50-99% of world exports (steel 98% at the start, falling to 65% in the canon year; clothes 86-88%; furniture, luxury goods, silk, porcelain, telephones, merchant marine...); unaffected: 100%-share goods while they stay at 100%.

_predictions.if the markup binds: the run diverges from the canon within weeks; the affected goods' world prices lower by up to ~0.2 x their share
_predictions.load check: debug.log must NOT report WORLD_MARKET_MONOPOLY_THRESHOLD 'not specified', and error.log must not reject its value

_cost: 1 run x 1935.1.1 -> 1936.1.1 from a late save, about 5 min
_caveats: The save is a PLAYER game (Japan); the harness loads it as an observer game, so the AI runs Japan - identical in both arms.
The observer's autosaves overwrite the user's autosave slots and continue_game.json: backup save games BACKUP 20261017_2015 holds the originals, restored after the run.
Launch ONLY through tools/testbed/launch_detached.ps1 CALLED DIRECTLY from the PowerShell tool (landmine L30). Watch with short reads only - never tail -F a harness log (L29).
